description: Source code for ECM (Entitlement Control Message) generation and decoding in ClearKey CAS, including functions to decode ECM clear fields and extract content keys.

methods.name: DecodeECM
methods.description: Decodes an ECM buffer to extract the content key and populate asset and default fields.

methods.name: DecodeECMClearFields
methods.description: Decodes the clear fields of an ECM buffer to populate default fields and validate system and asset IDs.
